description: The mirror of FALS3's finding (Bitcoin favourites at 50c to 85c are overpriced 2 to 3 minutes before the close: PF 0.77 on 2,576 windows, z -4.97): buy the cheap side whose ask is 15c to 49c at the candle ending 180 s before the close, held to settlement. History already read (UNDER1 found this side positive), so only forward days count; REV1 is the registered forward read of the related cheap-NO rule (2026-11-05). 1 try.
